<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ms">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>PasioData — Unit Pengambilan KKPS</title>
  <meta name="description" content="PasioData: statistik pelajar, norma ambilan, pendaftaran, rekod status, mesyuarat dan promosi Kolej Komuniti Pasir Salak dalam satu paparan.">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#070B24">
  <meta property="og:title" content="PasioData — Unit Pengambilan KKPS">
  <meta property="og:description" content="Data pengambilan Kolej Komuniti Pasir Salak dalam satu paparan.">
  <meta property="og:type" content="website">
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://script.google.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    html,body{height:100%;background:#070B24;font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;color:#E2E8F0;overflow:hidden}
    #app{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block;background:#fff;opacity:0;transition:opacity .45s ease}
    body.ready #app{opacity:1}
    /* Skrin pemuatan */
    #splash{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;transition:opacity .5s ease,visibility .5s}
    body.ready #splash{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
    .glow{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}
    .g1{width:560px;height:560px;background:#2E3192;left:-160px;top:-160px;animation:float 14s ease-in-out infinite}
    .g2{width:460px;height:460px;background:#F7941D;right:-140px;bottom:-140px;opacity:.3;animation:float 17s ease-in-out infinite reverse}
    .grid{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(148,163,184,.07) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(148,163,184,.07) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#000 25%,transparent 70%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#000 25%,transparent 70%)}
    @keyframes float{50%{transform:translate(40px,30px)}}
    .box{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:24px;max-width:520px}
    .mark{display:block;width:96px;height:96px;margin:0 auto 22px}
    .mark path{fill:none;stroke-width:30;stroke-dasharray:300;stroke-dashoffset:300;animation:draw 1.4s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) forwards}
    .mark .l1{stroke:#F7941D}
    .mark .l2{stroke:#3B3FB6;animation-delay:.3s}
    @keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
    .logo{display:inline-block;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:8px 14px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
    .logo img{height:40px;display:block}
    h1{font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,44px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#fff}
    p.sub{margin-top:6px;color:#94A3B8;font-size:15px}
    .bar{width:220px;height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);margin:26px auto 0;overflow:hidden}
    .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:40%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F7941D,#818CF8);animation:load 1.3s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes load{0%{transform:translateX(-110%)}100%{transform:translateX(280%)}}
    .msg{margin-top:18px;font-size:13px;color:#7C8AA5;min-height:20px}
    .actions{display:none;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
    body.slow .actions{display:flex}
    .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:999px;color:#1E1B4B;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FDBA74,#F7941D);border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
    .btn.ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#E2E8F0;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
    .setup{display:none;margin-top:22px;text-align:left;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;color:#CBD5E1}
    .setup code{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:6px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:12.5px;color:#FDBA74}
    body.unset .setup{display:block}
    body.unset .bar{display:none}
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.mark path{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="splash" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <span class="glow g1"></span><span class="glow g2"></span><span class="grid"></span>
    <div class="box">
      <svg class="mark" viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true"><path class="l1" d="M15 110 V15 H90"/><path class="l2" d="M45 120 V45 H120"/></svg>
      <div class="logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Kolej Komuniti Pasir Salak"></div>
      <h1>PasioData</h1>
      <p class="sub">Unit Pengambilan · Kolej Komuniti Pasir Salak</p>
      <div class="bar"><i></i></div>
      <div class="msg" id="msg">Memuatkan sistem…</div>
      <div class="actions">
        <a class="btn" id="direct" href="#" target="_top" rel="noopener">Buka terus</a>
        <button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="location.reload()">Cuba lagi</button>
      </div>
      <div class="setup">
        <b>Tetapan belum lengkap.</b><br>
        Buka fail <code>index.html</code> ini dan gantikan nilai <code>GAS_URL</code> dengan URL Web App Google Apps Script PasioData (berakhir dengan <code>/exec</code>), kemudian deploy semula di Netlify.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <iframe id="app" title="PasioData — Unit Pengambilan KKPS" allow="clipboard-write; fullscreen" referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"></iframe>

  <script>
    /* =====================================================================
       TETAPAN — gantikan dengan URL Web App Apps Script anda (Deploy → Manage deployments → Web app URL)
       ===================================================================== */
    var GAS_URL = 'https://script.google.com/a/macros/kkpsa.edu.my/s/AKfycby4fCPzlNg_ow28Ltdt7YKGoXLaT-OAz080Hivb4olHzJahw6vysspDu9FYBMmh3gvH/exec';

    (function () {
      var body = document.body, frame = document.getElementById('app'), msg = document.getElementById('msg');
      if (/GANTI_DENGAN/.test(GAS_URL) || !/^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/(a\/[^/]+\/)?macros\/s\/[\w-]{20,}\/exec\/?$/.test(GAS_URL)) {
        body.classList.add('unset');
        msg.textContent = '';
        return;
      }
      // Hantar parameter (cth. ?mohon=1, ?bil=SESI, ?panduan=SESI, ?borang=ID) & hash kepada Apps Script
      var target = GAS_URL + (location.search || '') + (location.hash || '');
      document.getElementById('direct').href = target;
      frame.src = target;
      var done = false;
      frame.addEventListener('load', function () {
        if (done) return; done = true;
        setTimeout(function () { body.classList.add('ready'); }, 250);
      });
      // Jika lambat (rangkaian / sekatan pelayar), tawarkan pautan terus
      setTimeout(function () {
        if (done) return;
        body.classList.add('slow');
        msg.textContent = 'Sistem mengambil masa lebih lama daripada biasa untuk dimuatkan.';
      }, 15000);
    })();
  </script>
  <noscript><p style="position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;color:#fff">Sila aktifkan JavaScript untuk menggunakan PasioData.</p></noscript>
</body>
</html>
